mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requests (room_number, request_content, status, requested_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roomNumber}, #{requestContent}, 'pending', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM requests WHERE status <> 'completed' ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM requests WHERE status = 'completed' ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM requests WHERE room_number=#{roomNumber} ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE requests SET status='confirmed', confirmed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
UPDATE requests SET status='completed', completed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='confirmed'
